headlines.title: Ireland beats Israel 3-0 wearing black armbands to support Gaza
Israeli far-right minister calls for annexation of South Litani area
61m tonnes of rubble: Gaza aid workers face delicate task of clearing ruins concealing up to 10,000 bodies
Ed Miliband to acknowledge Labour’s former stance on Palestine fell short
Israeli media says Netanyahu made unannounced visit to UAE

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
An Israeli far-right minister has called for the annexation of the South Litani area. [1]

KEY RISKS
The most severe government travel advisory for Israel is Reconsider Travel, reflecting risks to safety and security. [E2]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market related to Israel, "Israel military action against Lebanon on September 30?", is priced Yes at 88% as of Sep 28, 2026, and closes Sep 30, 2026. [E5]
A Polymarket market related to Israel, "Will the Bank of Israel make no change to the Bank of Israel Interest Rate after the October decision?", is priced Yes at 86% as of Sep 28, 2026, and closes Oct 21, 2026. [E6]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the Polymarket market on whether Israel will take military action against Lebanon on September 30, 2026, remains unresolved. [E5]
The outcome of the Polymarket market on whether Benjamin Netanyahu will be the next Prime Minister of Israel is unresolved until Oct 27, 2026. [E7]
